outlook_attach_to_draft.rationale: Pass-through (precursor): draft editing. A draft reaches nobody; outlook_send_draft is the governed release point.

outlook_batch_triage.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): message triage the assistant exists to perform. Internal, reversible, and invisible outside the mailbox.

outlook_categorize_message.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): message triage the assistant exists to perform. Internal, reversible, and invisible outside the mailbox.

outlook_changes_since.rationale: Pass-through (read): mailbox content the account's own token already reaches.

outlook_complete_task.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): Microsoft To Do task management. Personal task list, no external effect.

outlook_copy_message.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): message triage the assistant exists to perform. Internal, reversible, and invisible outside the mailbox.

outlook_create_contact.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): personal address book maintenance. No external effect and no customer record.

outlook_create_draft.rationale: Pass-through (precursor): draft editing. A draft reaches nobody; outlook_send_draft is the governed release point.

outlook_create_event.rationale: Creates a calendar event, sending invitations to attendees outside the organization.

outlook_create_task.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): Microsoft To Do task management. Personal task list, no external effect.

outlook_delete_contact.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): personal address book maintenance. No external effect and no customer record.

outlook_delete_draft.rationale: Pass-through (precursor): draft editing. A draft reaches nobody; outlook_send_draft is the governed release point.

outlook_delete_event.rationale: Deletes an event, cancelling and notifying attendees when the account is the organizer.

outlook_delete_folder.rationale: Deletes a user-created mail folder and its contents.

outlook_delete_inbox_override.rationale: Borderline: removes a per-sender rule, restoring default inbox behaviour. Governed for symmetry with set_inbox_override.

outlook_delete_message.rationale: Deletes a message, with permanent=True performing an unrecoverable hard delete.

outlook_delete_task.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): Microsoft To Do task management. Personal task list, no external effect.

outlook_download_attachment.rationale: Host-side effect. Writes decoded attachment bytes to a caller-supplied save_path on the Credential Adapter host — a write primitive on that machine, not merely a read of the message.

outlook_flag_message.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): message triage the assistant exists to perform. Internal, reversible, and invisible outside the mailbox.

outlook_forward.rationale: Forwards an existing message to new recipients — an egress path that can relay a confidential thread to an arbitrary address.

outlook_list_drafts.rationale: Pass-through (read): mailbox content the account's own token already reaches.

outlook_list_inbox.rationale: Pass-through (read): mailbox content the account's own token already reaches.

outlook_list_inbox_delta.rationale: Pass-through (read): mailbox content the account's own token already reaches.

outlook_list_thread.rationale: Pass-through (read): mailbox content the account's own token already reaches.

outlook_mark_read.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): message triage the assistant exists to perform. Internal, reversible, and invisible outside the mailbox.

outlook_move_message.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): message triage the assistant exists to perform. Internal, reversible, and invisible outside the mailbox.

outlook_read_message.rationale: Pass-through (read): mailbox content the account's own token already reaches.

outlook_read_messages.rationale: Pass-through (read): mailbox content the account's own token already reaches.

outlook_reclassify_message.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): message triage the assistant exists to perform. Internal, reversible, and invisible outside the mailbox.

outlook_remove_draft_attachment.rationale: Pass-through (precursor): draft editing. A draft reaches nobody; outlook_send_draft is the governed release point.

outlook_reply.rationale: Replies or replies-all to a message, reaching every recipient on the thread.

outlook_rsvp.rationale: Borderline: outbound, but the payload is only accept, decline, or tentative, and an RSVP can be changed. Operators who do not want a signature here should set proposerOnly.

outlook_search_mail.rationale: Pass-through (read): mailbox content the account's own token already reaches.

outlook_send_draft.rationale: Releases a prepared draft. This is the governed chokepoint that makes the draft-editing tools safe to pass through.

outlook_send_message.rationale: Sends an email immediately with no human review, under the account's identity. Cannot be recalled.

outlook_send_with_attachments.rationale: Sends an email with attached files. Cannot be recalled, and carries file contents outward.

outlook_set_inbox_override.rationale: Creates a sticky per-sender Focused/Other rule — standing automation that keeps acting with no human present, and can quietly divert security notifications.

outlook_switch_account.rationale: Re-targeting. Changes the active account, so a later approved send goes out from a different mailbox than the approver had in mind.

outlook_update_contact.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): personal address book maintenance. No external effect and no customer record.

outlook_update_draft.rationale: Pass-through (precursor): draft editing. A draft reaches nobody; outlook_send_draft is the governed release point.

outlook_update_event.rationale: Updates an event, notifying attendees of the change.

outlook_update_task.rationale: Pass-through (routine-job): Microsoft To Do task management. Personal task list, no external effect.
